The plate is about 400 px across, so if it is a 26 cm dinner plate, that is roughly 0.065 cm per px. The food covers about 200 px by 150 px, which is about 13 cm by 10 cm at most, but it is likely two small pieces of pizza, each about 6 cm square.

The pieces look like thick-crust pizza squares, possibly focaccia-style. Each is roughly 6×6×2 cm, so about 70 cm³ per piece. With a bread-like density of about 0.5 g/cm³ for the crust plus cheese, that is around 60-70 g per piece, or about 130 g for the two.

Pizza runs about 270 kcal per 100 g, so 130 g comes to roughly 350 kcal. The pieces may be smaller than that, so I'll settle on about 120 g and 320 kcal.
